_comment: Configuration for scripts/review/annotate_relevance.py. Paths are relative
to the repository root. Everything here has a working default in the script,
so a fresh project needs only `roots` and, optionally, `prefixes`.
_exclude_comment: Regexes matched against the discovered path, relative to the root's directory. Preamble includes carry no prose.
_prefixes_comment: File stem -> ID prefix. An identifier is <prefix>-<nn> for a paragraph and
<prefix>-C<n> for a caption, numbered in source order within the file, so an
ID stays stable as long as that file's block sequence does. Stems not listed
get initials of the stem, deduplicated; list a stem here only to pin a
_generated_comment: Files written by a generator. --apply still marks them, but re-running the generator drops the marker, so they are reported after every apply.
